first.text:
Kael stands at the campfire. Lyra sits next to him, reading.

Kael: "Can't you put that damn book down for once?"

Lyra: "Can you form a single thought without swearing?"

Kael: "You arrogant witch."

Lyra: "You remarkably primitive specimen of human evolution."

Both turn to you.

choices.text: Lyra, stop insulting him all the time.
You're behaving like children. Pull yourselves together.
If you want to fight, then fight.

calm.text:
Kael: "Fine by me."

Lyra: "Finally someone with a shred of sense."
